description: ansible_playbook: the resolved step payload is handed to the play as variables, so a playbook reads any runtime parameter the node supplied through an ordinary {{ key }} lookup. Targeting keys travel with it.
notes: REPLACES snippets.ansible_playbook.extra_vars_is_a_key_not_the_payload, which asserted that ONLY a declared variables key reached the play. No implementation has ever done that: the oracle passes input.GetRawText() (AnsibleHandler.cs) and so does Nashira, both with a comment saying the payload is how a playbook reads runtime parameters. The old assertion was written from the specification's prose rather than reified from the oracle, which is the kit's own rule; the specification was corrected instead. What the play receives is invisible in the step's output, so this asserts the process arguments.
